description: A group of inherited disorders characterised by skin and mucosal fragility with blister formation after minor trauma.
causes: Inherited defects affecting structural proteins of the skin

appearance.general: Blisters and erosions may occur after minor friction or trauma; severity and distribution vary by subtype.

warning_signs: Extensive blistering, infection, dehydration, difficulty swallowing, or breathing problems require urgent medical care.
general_first_aid: Protect fragile skin from friction and trauma.
Seek medical care for extensive blistering or signs of infection.
prevention: Reduce friction and avoid avoidable trauma to fragile skin.
